newsitem.title: USA: Best places Aon insurance units under review.
newsitem.headline: Best places Aon insurance units under review.

text.p: A.M. Best Co said that effective immediately, it has placed Aon Corp's insurance units under review with negative implications.
Best said the ratings affected are Combined Insurance Co of America, Combined Life Insurance Co of New York, and Virginia Surety Co - all of which are rated "A+" (Superior).
The insurance rating company said the action follows yesterday's merger deal, under which Aon will acquire Alexander & Alexander Services Inc for $1.23 billion in cash.

Best said the units have been placed under review because of the uncertainty concerning the financing details and the impact any debt incurred in connection with the transaction would have on the organization with respect to Best's expectations for "Superior" rated firms.
The ratings will remain under review pending further discussions with the management of Aon.
